title: Rey against the First Order
description: Following her duel with Kylo Ren, Rey escapes his quarters, hoping to get off the steadfast before Ren can return to his flagship. Ren arrives to find Rey in the hangar, and corners her against the hangar door, and reveals her true lineage. Just as Ren again offers for Rey to join him, the Millennium Falcon roars up and blasts the stormtroopers back.
